After Jul 2018, F3_Z01 jumped to ~25.1°C, now matching F1_Z01 and diverging ~1.5–2°C from its floor neighbors, which only shifted by the normal seasonal amount (~0.4–0.9°C). Its VAV damper setpoint continues the same seasonal pattern with no step at Jul 2018, and the setpoints (cooling/heating) are unchanged and shared across zones. A step change confined to a single zone's sensor reading, diverging from physically co-located sensors on the same floor, is consistent with a sensor fault rather than a real local load change.
